description:
АСВП, Ukraine's register of enforcement proceedings (виконавчі провадження).

Wider than ЄРБ (`ua_debtors`): it keeps closed ('Завершено') and refused
('Відмовлено у відкритті') proceedings too. The shared key is `vp_num`.

`debtor_code` is published for legal entities only, about 9% of rows. The source
carries no identifier at all for a natural-person debtor, so a null code means
the source publishes none, not that parsing failed.
name: ua_enforcement_proceedings__search
title: Search Enforcement Proceedings
